case_title: Savitri Pandey and Another v. State of U.P. and Others
neutral_facts: The case involves a dispute over land ownership and sale deeds executed in 1994. The complainant, who is a relative of the accused, lodged a First Information Report (FIR) alleging fraud in the execution of the sale deeds. The accused were named in the FIR but no specific role was assigned to them. The complainant had not previously filed any civil suit to cancel the sale deeds. The parties involved are close relatives with joint property in the village, and the land in question was part of their joint family property. The High Court dismissed the FIR, but the Supreme Court found that the FIR was an abuse of process of law due to the complainant's delayed allegations and lack of specific role assignment to the accused.
